action.objective: Verify Nxc6 (d4c6), the reserved suggestion, at full depth 4 before committing.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 suggested d4c6 with exact score -44, but that was shallow and the only commit-ready path is single-candidate verification. d4c6 wins the c6 knight, though d7c6 recaptures the bishop; it also frees the d4 square and reduces Black's minor pressure. Must confirm at depth 4 that no refutation exists (e.g., c5 captures, tactics on a4/d4). This uses the reserved 2000-node allowance.
